interpretation_limits: Only one case and the first mask-selected event; no p-values, confidence intervals or population ASR. Repeated horizons/targets are correlated.
Native-gate shadows retain only the admission predicate and correct timestamps; they are not the actual native calibration states, which include placeholders and the old indexing bug.
The full-feedback control uses simulator truth unavailable to a deployed agent and is diagnostic, not a defense.

Current point forecasts, native policy goal, weights and physical environment were never attacked. All actual utility is from the single real Clean rollout; three shadow rows are not three policy episodes.
Interval mean is not monotonically larger under full feedback at every horizon; all h1..5 values are reported.
Feedback-selective labels are an established concept. This result provides no novelty score or claim of theoretical coverage guarantees.
